I am writing to apply for the Content Migration Specialist position in Brussels. With my hands-on experience in content management and CMS platforms, particularly WordPress, and my strong attention to detail, I am confident in my ability to support your client's website migration and launch.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage content uploads, structure pages, and ensure SEO best practices, which has honed my skills in organizing and formatting content for web. Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear ACENSI team,

I am excited to apply for the Content Migration Specialist role at ACENSI, as advertised. With a strong background in content management, CMS platforms, and web content structuring, I am well-prepared to support your client's corporate website migration and ensure a smooth launch.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I am responsible for on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site management. I regularly upload and structure content, ensuring it aligns with the site architecture and templates. This experience has given me a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of how to organize content for optimal user experience and search visibility.

One of my key projects, mirook.com, involved building a multi-page WordPress site from scratch. I designed the site structure, implemented metadata and tagging, and ensured content consistency across all pages. This project required close coordination with the client to gather content and meet deadlines, which mirrors the responsibilities of the Content Migration Specialist role.

I am proficient in using CMS platforms, with WordPress being my primary tool. I am also familiar with Sitecore, as I have worked with it in a previous role. My technical background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) allows me to understand the technical aspects of content migration and troubleshoot issues proactively.

I possess strong organizational skills, able to manage multiple tasks in parallel while maintaining high quality. I am a hands-on and pragmatic problem-solver, with excellent communication skills to collaborate with various stakeholders. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch, and I am available to work on-site in Brussels.

I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to your team and support a successful website launch. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing my qualifications further.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
